decomp_verification.finding: HGSS does not present Nature-modified stats with dedicated stat-label sprites. The Summary screen renders the stat names as text and selects one of three packed text-color parameters according to the corresponding gNatureStatMods entry.

native_color_behavior.note: These are recorded as the exact packed HGSS text-color arguments used by sub_0208C7F8. This phase does not infer or fabricate replacement RGB values.

current_expansion_legacy.presentation: five 16x16 stat-label sprite frames; separate palettes indicate Nature increase/decrease

adaptation_rule: Replace the legacy sprite-label presentation with dynamic text following HGSS Summary behavior. Use authentic HGSS font/text presentation and the verified Nature color-state semantics; do not draw HGSS-style stat-label sprites.
status: phase 1 complete: authentic HGSS Nature-stat presentation verified as colored text rather than sprite labels; legacy stat_labels.png remains live
next: Phase 2: replace the live 16x16 stat-label sprites with HGSS-derived dynamic stat-name text and native increase/decrease/neutral color behavior, retaining stat_labels.png only for verification until the new path passes CI.
